goal: native Codex setup and existing-daemon diagnosis
scope: Read-only installed CLI help, generated local schemas, official Codex documentation, and local Unix-socket/process metadata. No socket connections, native app-server initialization, provider turns, credential-content reads, auth changes, protected permission changes, or auth copies were made.

installed_cli.app_server_help: codex app-server supports stdio, unix://, and unix://PATH listeners; --code-mode-host supplies an outbound remote Code Mode host.
installed_cli.proxy_help: codex app-server proxy accepts --sock SOCKET_PATH and proxies stdio bytes to an already-running app-server control socket.
installed_cli.daemon_help: Lists start, restart, stop, version, and bootstrap operations; none were invoked.

client_capabilities.basis: Installed ClientRequest entries for thread/goal/set and thread/goal/get have no experimental annotation. Official App Server API overview lists them as regular goal methods; it explicitly labels other gated APIs and fields as experimental. B does not send experimentalApi or any experimental field.

initialize_schema.source_filter_impact: B now validates the four installed response fields and absolute codexHome path; it does not inspect, store, or return codexHome.

runtime_state_diagnosis.prior_native_attempt: Recorded in evidence/B/B2-readiness.json: stdio startup failed before initialize response with EROFS while attempting CODEX_HOME/tmp/arg0, uid_map and CODEX_HOME/installation_id writes.

prior_overrides.sqlite_home: A host-selected directory under /tmp; exact value was not retained in B evidence.
prior_overrides.log_dir: A host-selected directory under /tmp; exact value was not retained in B evidence.
prior_overrides.result: Both SQLite runtime state and logs were redirected; the unrelated CODEX_HOME writes still failed.

documented_settings.sqlite_home: Directory for SQLite-backed runtime DB and resumable runtime state; it does not relocate other CODEX_HOME runtime files.
documented_settings.log_dir: Directory for local logs; explicit setting also enables opt-in plaintext TUI logging.

runtime_state_diagnosis.ordinary_config_fix: No documented CLI/config setting was found for the observed path-alias, uid_map, or installation_id writes. A temp CODEX_HOME would not retain the existing authenticated state by itself.

existing_daemon_route.supported_if_present: The installed proxy supports --sock SOCKET_PATH; official app-server docs describe Unix transport through the default control socket or a custom Unix socket path.
local_metadata_checks: Filesystem Unix-socket search under /home, /run/codex-environment and /tmp found no Codex app-server socket.
ss -xlpn and /proc/net/unix showed no Codex app-server control socket; visible sockets were container/runtime services.
The Codex-named process identified by command metadata was the cloud exec-server, not an app-server daemon.
existing_daemon_route.conclusion: There is no discoverable already-authenticated app-server daemon socket in this environment to pass to codex app-server proxy. --code-mode-host is a Code Mode host setting, not a route to a local logged-in daemon. No route was tested by connecting.

official_sources.title: Codex App Server
claims: Unix transport can use the default app-server control socket or a custom Unix socket path.
--code-mode-host controls the outbound Code Mode host and does not change app-server's listener transport.
thread/goal/set and thread/goal/get are listed as goal APIs; other experimental fields/methods are explicitly marked as gated.
account/rateLimits/read fetches ChatGPT rate limits; usedPercent and resetsAt describe quota windows, and credits are separate workspace-credit details.

official_sources.title: Codex Configuration Reference
claims: sqlite_home stores the SQLite-backed runtime DB used by agent jobs and resumable runtime state.
log_dir selects local log output and does not relocate other CODEX_HOME state.

official_sources.title: Codex Configuration Basics
claims: Codex uses user-level configuration and CLI/config overrides; project config is separate and does not turn a temporary CODEX_HOME into an authenticated host state directory.

remaining_blockers: Native initialization, live catalog/account/quota read, and any provider turn remain unverified; the prior EROFS failure was not retried.
A host-provided writable runtime mount preserving the existing CODEX_HOME authentication state or an already-running host-owned daemon socket is required before a native readiness probe can proceed.
Subscription quota signals do not enforce max_cost_usd; no provider execution is permitted under the existing hard-dollar contract.
